benchmark_name: M1 Photogrammetric Quality Checker vs BRISQUE NSS Benchmark
task: T13 / M1 Empirical Image Quality Assessment
sample_dataset: Post-disaster aerial/drone video frames (South Fork & Wayanad disaster zones)

standard_check.method: Photogrammetry standard check (Laplacian variance + luminance + 256-bin histogram saturation clipping)

brisque.method: BRISQUE (Blind/Referenceless Image Spatial Quality Evaluator - Natural Scene Statistics)

comparative_analysis.root_cause_for_brisque_failure: Disaster-zone fractured scree, boulder fields, and turbulent riverbeds exhibit high localized contrast that artificially lowers BRISQUE distortion scores on motion-blurred frames, creating 6 false positives that would corrupt photogrammetric bundle adjustment.
